title: FGF Brands Inc. — FDA Enforcement Intelligence
excerpt: Enforcement intelligence profile for FGF Brands Inc., covering 60 recall actions triggered by a single massive Listeria event at the company's Brownsburg, Indiana donut facility. Over 2 million cases of baked goods — including products supplied to Dunkin' and major grocery retailers — were voluntarily recalled in January 2025 after environmental Listeria detection, exposing the concentration risk inherent in private-label bakery manufacturing.
